description.en: The ID of the CEN instance.

description.zh:
云企业网实例的描述信息。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头。
description.en:
The description of the CEN instance.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a letter or Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
云企业网实例的名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头。
description.en:
The name of the CEN instance.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
设置网段重叠的级别。

取值：**REDUCED**（默认值），表示网段可以有重叠，但是不能完全相同。
description.en:
The level of CIDR block overlapping.

Set the value to **REDUCED** (default). This value specifies that CIDR blocks can overlap but cannot be the same.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn modify-cen-attribute --cen-id cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc0000 --name test --description cen --protection-level REDUCED --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cbn ModifyCenAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --ProtectionLevel REDUCED --Description cen --CenId 'cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc0000' --Name test
